abstract: PURPOSE: To compare relapse rates and toxicity associated with para-aortic (PA) strip or PA and ipsilateral iliac lymph node irradiation (dogleg [DL] field) (30 Gy/15 fractions/3 weeks) for stage I testicular seminoma. PATIENTS AND METHODS: Between July 1989 and May 1993, 478 men with testicular seminoma stage I (T1 to T3; no ipsilateral inguinoscrotal operation before orchiectomy) were randomized (PA, 236 patients; DL, 242 patients). RESULTS: Median follow-up time is 4.5 years. Eighteen relapses, nine in each treatment group, have occurred 4 to 35 months after radiotherapy; among these, four were pelvic relapses, all occurring after PA radiotherapy. However, the 95% confidence interval (CI) for the difference in pelvic relapse rates excludes differences of more than 4%. The 3-year relapse-free survival was 96% (95% CI, 94% to 99%) after PA radiotherapy and 96.6% (95% CI, 94% to 99%) after DL (difference, 0.6%; 95% confidence limits, -3.4%, +4.6%). One patient (PA field) has died from seminoma. Survival at 3 years was 99.3% for PA and 100% for DL radiotherapy. Acute toxicity (nausea, vomiting, leukopenia) was less frequent and less pronounced in patients in the PA arm. Within the first 18 months of follow-up, the sperm counts were significantly higher after PA than after DL irradiation. CONCLUSION: In patients with testicular seminoma stage I (T1 to T3) and with undisturbed lymphatic drainage, adjuvant radiotherapy confined to the PA lymph nodes is associated with reduced hematologic, gastrointestinal, and gonadal toxicity, but with a higher risk of pelvic recurrence, compared with DL radiotherapy. The recurrence rate is low with either treatment. PA radiotherapy is recommended as standard treatment in these patients.
abstract_ja:
目的：傍大動脈(PA)ストリップ照射、または傍大動脈および同側腸骨リンパ節への照射(ドッグレッグ[DL]照射野)(30 Gy/15分割/3週間)による、病期I精巣セミノーマに対する再発率と毒性を比較すること。
患者と方法：1989年7月から1993年5月の間に、病期I精巣セミノーマの男性478例(T1〜T3、精巣摘除術前に同側鼠径陰嚢部手術を受けていない)を無作為に割り付けた(PA群236例、DL群242例)。
結果：追跡期間中央値は4.5年である。放射線療法後4〜35か月の間に18例の再発が生じ(各治療群9例)、そのうち4例は骨盤内再発で、いずれもPA照射後に生じた。ただし、骨盤内再発率の差の95%信頼区間は4%を超える差を除外している。放射線療法後の3年無再発生存率は、PA群で96%(95%CI 94〜99%)、DL群で96.6%(95%CI 94〜99%)であった(差0.6%、95%信頼限界 -3.4%、+4.6%)。セミノーマで死亡したのは1例のみ(PA照射野)であった。3年生存率はPA群99.3%、DL群100%であった。急性毒性(悪心、嘔吐、白血球減少)はPA群で頻度が低く、程度も軽かった。追跡の最初の18か月間では、精子数はDL照射後よりPA照射後で有意に高かった。
結論：リンパ流が正常な病期I(T1〜T3)の精巣セミノーマ患者において、傍大動脈リンパ節のみに限定した補助放射線療法は、DL照射と比較して血液毒性、消化管毒性、性腺毒性が少ないが、骨盤内再発のリスクは高い。いずれの治療でも再発率は低い。これらの患者に対する標準治療としてPA照射を推奨する。
